text: The hour between day and night is called Pradosha.
Our tradition holds that what is unsettled in our minds can be set down there.
On this sacred day, we remember Lord Shiva as the one who takes what we cannot carry.
You are invited to offer an abhishekam with water or milk, or simply light a deepam before His picture.
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' for as long as it feels natural to you.
Offer Bilva leaves if you have them; your puja is no less complete if you do not.
